requirements.verifier_assertion: The rendered rubric fires on the artifact located at /eddy-current-damping-sim_0100/index.html (workspace root, exact filename). iv_verify.py loads that path in headless Chromium and any generated rubric assumes a single-file HTML entry.

The artifact must be self-contained (no external CDN / no http(s) / no protocol-relative //host references). iv_verify.py runs the rubric in a browser environment where any external fetch will fail; a missing resource produces a blank render and every rubric item collapses to 0.

iv_shipped_checklist #1 — 'Magnet drag and release response': magnet follows pointer, decelerates naturally after release due to damping, stays within plate bounds. Any generated rubric would also inspect drag responsiveness. Requires the F_d = -k v damping law wired to pointer input.
must_include: drag the magnet freely across the plate
motion should visibly slow due to eddy-current damping

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist #2 — 'Core parameter sliders take effect in real-time': dragging Br, sigma, thickness, gap sliders syncs numeric outputs and changes eddy-current intensity or drag readings.

iv_shipped_checklist #3 — 'Eddy-current streamline animation and color mapping': streamlines animate; color gradient is blue (low density) -> red (high density). Directional cue matches induction. The 4.5.2 trap would otherwise flip this mapping.
must_include: blue is LOW density, red is HIGH density

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist #4 — 'Quantitative drag and velocity readout display': readouts refresh continuously, drag in N and velocity in m/s, values track drag speed. Units matter — 'm/s' and 'N' are the exact strings any rubric grader anchors against.

iv_shipped_checklist #5 — 'Responsive layout and fullscreen toggle': resizing rescales canvas maintaining aspect ratio; #btn-full or F toggles fullscreen (not Escape — the 4.5.2 trap notes otherwise). UI does not overlap after resize.
must_include: Fullscreen toggle is either the #btn-full button or the F keyboard shortcut

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist #6 — 'Material presets and extended parameter binding': #sel-material dropdown drives sigma and plate tint; mu_r and mass sliders feed the physics engine. Material presets required by the instruction (Copper, Aluminum, Steel).

iv_shipped_checklist #7 — 'Display layer toggles and history plot': checkboxes control streamlines / arrows / flux footprint / live graph; #graph canvas draws scrolling dual-axis time-series with a legend.

iv_shipped_checklist #8 — 'Fling/Pause/Reset controls and keyboard shortcuts': three buttons wired with matching Space/R/F shortcuts, state transitions leave no residue (no ghost particles after Reset).
